reject: why-types-node: its major must match the Node runtime major in .nvmrc (18); a higher major only weakens type checking; bump together with the runtime
why-typescript: 7.0.2 fails npm install with ERESOLVE against the ts lint parser peer range (<6.1.0) and its Go-built tsgo binaries add Go stdlib findings to the Grype scan (re-tested 2026-10-20)
why-eslint: 10.x cannot be installed by npm ci - eslint-plugin-import 2.32.0 (latest) declares a peer range that stops at eslint 9 (re-tested 2026-10-20)
why-redocly: 2.x needs Node 20+ (build:api fails with File is not defined on Node 18.20.4); held at the 1.34.x line (re-tested 2026-10-20)

why-sdk-scheme-adapter: 24.x is a Yarn workspace package whose postinstall runs yarn husky install and fails under npm, and its API moved six majors away from the 18.x this service codes against (re-tested 2026-10-20)

why-esm-only-libs: sdk-standard-components 19, api-snippets 18, central-services-shared 19 and openapi-backend 5.21+ all require the ESM-only json-schema-ref-parser 16, which Node 18 cannot require() and ts-jest 29 cannot transform; they move together with the Node 20+ runtime bump (re-tested 2026-10-20)
why-commander: 15.x is ESM-only and this CommonJS build on Node 18 cannot require it (re-tested 2026-10-20)
why-redis: redis 4+ replaces the callback client with a promise-based one and generic RedisClient types; src/shared/redis-connection.ts and kvs.ts need a rewrite first (re-tested 2026-10-20)

why-jest: jest 30 removes the toThrowError/toBeCalled* matcher aliases the suites use and needs NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules for the ESM tree; staged as its own migration together with the runtime bump (re-tested 2026-10-20)
